summary: @servicetitan/html-sketchapp preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package's preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<platform>.zip to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB obfuscated JavaScript file `math_init.js` at the tarball root. Both `setup.mjs` and `math_init.js` are heavily obfuscated: `setup.mjs` uses `_0xNNNN` identifier indirection and dictionary-based string obfuscation to hide platform detection, download, and exec logic; `math_init.js` is a `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle with a shuffled string-array rotator (`WV8StW` shifting `MmgoCP`) and hex-mangled identifiers, with no readable control flow. Neither `math_init.js` nor `setup.mjs` is declared in `package.json`'s `files` array, though the manifest enumerates the package's real content (`asketch2sketch`, `html2asketch`, `build/...`) — the executed payload is present in the tarball but absent from the author's declared file manifest. The package's advertised purpose is HTML-to-Sketch conversion and has no functional need for a separate language runtime or a file named `math_init.js`. This matches the alternate-runtime dropper pattern: pulling in Bun to execute an opaque bundle smuggles code execution on install past Node-oriented inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
